description_en: Queries the information about instances in a manually triggered workflow
description_zh: 获取手动执行的业务流程实例的信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-manual-dag-instances --project-env RPOD --project-name test_workspace --dag-id 7000001231241 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListManualDagInstances

parameters.help_en: The environment of Operation Center. Valid values: PROD and DEV
parameters.help_zh: 运维中心的调度环境标识，包括PROD（生产环境）和DEV（开发环境）
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The name of the workspace to which the manually triggered workflow belongs. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the name
parameters.help_zh: 手动业务流程所属的工作空间名称。您可以进入DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，在工作空间配置页面获取
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the directed acyclic graph (DAG) for the manually triggered workflow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212830.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 触发手动业务流程运行的Dag实例ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212830.html接口获取
parameters.name: dag_id
